'''Pex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he visited theaters on various [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to sell props which storytellers could use for retelling exciting stories.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pex appeared as a non-player character (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Pex was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Storytelling|Storyteller system]],<ref name="Storyteller">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66938&resource=features|text=Storyteller}}</ref> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> The developers of the game added a small chance for every generic storyteller vendor NPC (who sold props for players to use in self-created events) to spawn with the name Pex.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?start=0&topic_id=687086&|text=Pex Tribute, What Have You}}</ref> This Pex originally had a random appearance that was different from the generic storyteller vendor NPC. This random appearance was later changed to a zombie version of the standard storyteller vendor.<ref name="SWG" />

This NPC was added as a tribute to [[Jason Ryan|Jason "Pex" Ryan]], who was the events manager of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' from [[August]] [[2003]]<ref name="SWG Forum">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swggpdiscussion&message.id=994272|text=Meet the SWG Devs and Team: Come Say Hi!}}</ref> to [[May]] [[2008]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.engadget.com/2008-05-05-ending-of-event-support-for-star-wars-galaxies-marks-eras-close.html|text=Ending of event support for Star Wars Galaxies marks era's close|author=Zenke, Michael|date=2008-05-05|archivedate=20200903233917}}</ref> He organized and supported many in-game events, often playing famous characters like [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] or [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] at such events.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.tentonhammer.com/articles/swg-dev-diary-with-jason-pex-ryan|text=SWG: Dev Diary with Jason "Pex" Ryan|author=Hertzberg, Karen|date=2007-08-22|archivedate=20200903232534}}</ref>
